Hello Shaffer Construction 

I wanted to personally congratulate you on the success of Shaffer Construction. Earning and maintaining a 5★ rating is no small feat — it’s a clear sign that you run a high-performing business that customers trust. I work with a select group of owners of exceptional service companies like yours who have been approached by private equity firms or strategic buyers . My role is to help them evaluate offers, negotiate from a position of strength, and understand the true market value of their business before taking the next step. If you’ve been contacted or even if you’re just curious what your company might be worth, I’d be happy to walk you through the process, share a few success stories from clients in similar positions and provide a complimentary valuation based on metrics you already have. Schedule your complimentary valuation session or a time to talk here: https://calendly.com/kevin-darbridge/30min 
Warm regards,
Kevin Hanratty 
Founder | Darbridge Advisors
